Given the combination of poor momentum, stretched valuations, insider selling, and high volatility, the asymmetric risk-reward setup is firmly skewed to the downside. In line with Druckenmiller's principles, I would avoid this position and seek more favorable growth and momentum opportunities elsewhere.
